title: Clouds and Rain
overview: Gray skies mirror the group's uneasy mood. Momoka senses a chance to get closer to Minato, while Miki can barely face Yota after turning him down.

title: Stop and Go
overview: Cultural festival prep begins and Miki and Yota ease back to normal. But as Minato grapples with his desire to stay close to Koyuki, Momoka makes a move.

title: True Feelings
overview: Reeling from the news that Minato and Momoka are dating, Koyuki fights to keep her composure. Miki, meanwhile, confronts Minato about his true intentions.

title: Relief
overview: In agony over Minato, Koyuki confides in Tsukiko — who sees what Koyuki refuses to. Then a run-in with Igarashi forces her to reflect on her own walls.

title: Transition
overview: Miki watches the group joke around at the bowling alley, amazed by how normal it all seems. Beneath the surface, though, no one's feelings are the same.

title: Cultural Festival
overview: Summer's over and Class 2-2 takes the stage for the cultural festival. But while everyone else celebrates, Minato slowly realizes that something is off.

title: Misunderstandings
overview: Momoka suddenly asks Koyuki to meet — makes a pointed demand. Later, a surprise visitor at home forces Minato to face the reason for his stress.

title: Turning Points
overview: Autumn arrives. Minato crosses a line he's never dared to, Momoka rethinks what she wants in a relationship and Miki's heart catches up with her.
